items.title: 9.6 Common ion effect (common ion ka asar) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.6, printed pages 198-199.

blocks.title: Common ion effect
blocks.text: Kisi weak electrolyte mein aisa ion dalna jo us mein pehle se maujood ho (common ion), us ki ionization ko suppress (daba) deta hai. Isi ko common ion effect kehte hain.

Sodium chloride ko purify (saaf) karne ke liye brine (NaCl ka saturated solution) mein hydrogen chloride gas guzari jati hai. Solution mein sodium chloride poori tarah ionize hota hai. Is ka equilibrium constant expression yeh hai:
HCl bhi solution mein ionize hoti hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein “HCl(g) (s)” chhapa hai; HCl yahan gas hai, “(s)” ghalti se chhapa hai.

HCl gas guzarne se Cl⁻ ion ki concentration barh jati hai. Equilibrium constant ki value wahi rakhne ke liye NaCl crystal ban kar solution se bahar aa jata hai. Yahi common ion effect hai. Less soluble (kam ghulne wale) electrolyte ke solution mein common ion dalne se us ki ionization dab jati hai aur bina ionize hue (unionized) hisse ki concentration barh jati hai, jo precipitate (solid particles) ban kar nikal sakta hai.
